description.narrative: Insatsen syftar till att möjliggöra för UNDPs och DPAs gemensamma program för konfliktförebyggande att agera snabbt och effektivt på landnivå i krissituationer.

The intervention has the purpose of building national capacities for conflict prevention. This is done by facilitating rapid and efficient deployment of Peace and Development Advisors to assist UNDP's country offices in their efforts to implement programmes related to crisis response.

To preserve and advance human development by supporting the strengthening of national and local capacities to prevent, mitigate and recover from the effects of violent conflicts in priority countries.

The program contributed to develop and sustain conflict prevention capacities in 40 countries. The program has helped open entry points for conflict prevention initiative and facilitating the integration of a conflict-sensitive perspective into development programming. For a comprehensive review of results, see the statement on narrative reporting. Some examples of results: In Nigeria the PDA helped organize stakeholders' dialogues for peaceful elections and capacity building to national institutions to contribute to mitigate electoral-related violence. In Sri Lanka the PDA provided international experience on reconciliation commissions, including the incorporation of gender concerns. In Tunisia the PDA has provided support to make sure the UNCT is well informed and positioned to respond to political developments. In Bosnia Herzegovina, support to a national dialogue initiative to strengthen grassroot initiative and linking them to higher politics has been provided. altogether seven joint missions undertaken for joint analyses and sharing of strategies with RC and UNCT .
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
